changes.title: Moon
items: Before the first wave the dancefloor shows only the moon, going through its phases in soft twilight colours, and the full moon flares out into the party when the first wave comes
The moon in the sky now moves slowly across it over a run, waxes and wanes, and once in a while turns red, blue or harvest gold, tinting the moonlight a little

changes.title: No car roads
items: The old roads are gone from the forest: only footpaths, railways and streams cross it now (road signs, lampposts and the car park stay as relics)

changes.title: Music stops
items: The music no longer piles up notes when the game slows (which made it crackle and could silence it), and if the sound ever stops it starts itself again
